description: This Java class implements the ContentService interface, providing methods to manage content entities, handle content files and images, and interact with DAO layers for content-related operations within a Spring framework context.

classes.name: ContentServiceImpl
classes.description: A service class implementing content management operations, file handling, and interactions with data access objects (DAO) for content entities.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Retrieve a list of Content based on ContentType, Store, and Language.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Delete a Content entity by its instance.

methods.name: getByLanguage
methods.description: Retrieve content by ID and specific language.

methods.name: listNameByType
methods.description: Retrieve a list of ContentDescription filtered by ContentType, Store, and Language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieve content by code and store, with optional language parameter.

methods.name: addContentFile
methods.description: Add a content file (image or static file) to the store, based on content type.

methods.name: addLogo
methods.description: Add a logo image for the merchant store.

methods.name: addOptionImage
methods.description: Add an option image for the merchant store.

methods.name: addImage
methods.description: Internal method to add an image file to the store.

methods.name: addFile
methods.description: Internal method to add a general file to the store.

methods.name: addContentFiles
methods.description: Add multiple content files to a store.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Remove a specific file by name and type from the store.

methods.name: removeFiles
methods.description: Remove all files associated with a merchant store.

methods.name: getContentFile
methods.description: Retrieve a specific content file by name and type.

methods.name: getContentFiles
methods.description: Retrieve all content files of a specific type for a store.

methods.name: getContentFilesNames
methods.description: Retrieve the list of filenames for a specific content type in a store.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Get ContentDescription by store and SEO URL.
